title: SlotsPlus
description: Automatically replaces a tool with another of the same type from the inventory, immediately after it breaks, without changing the active slot.
body:
This mod automatically replaces a broken tool with another of the same type from the inventory, without changing the active slot. It works seamlessly to ensure uninterrupted gameplay by instantly switching to a new tool immediately after the current one breaks.

Main Features
Automatic tool replacement upon breakage
No need to manually change slots
Works only if a similar tool is available in the inventory
Smooth and seamless gameplay experience
